pages.text: Toss sweaty boots (boots carrying a sweat level) into any body of water and they start $(bold)rinsing clean$().$(br2)Time depends on level: base duration × (level + 1) — level 1 takes one unit, level 3 takes three.

While rinsing, $(bold)bubble particles$() rise around the boots to show progress; when done the sweat is removed and the custom name is restored — a plain pair of boots again.$(br2)Whether boots can be rinsed at all, and how long it takes, is decided by the host.
